correctness.rationale: Smith normal form of evaluation constraints at three points x,y,z exploits independent uniform a0,a1,a2. For the 3-by-3 Vandermonde, unit first Smith invariant, t=min capped valuations of three differences and s=min(k,sum valuations minus t) give joint-zero probability p^(-3k+t+s), including coincident points separately. Translation reduces E R^3 to p^(-2k) sum_{u,v} p^(t+s). Enumerating unique minimal-valuation patterns and one closer pair gives w0=(p-1)(p-2)/p^2, w_j=3(p-1)^2/p^(j+2), w_L=3(p-1)/p^(L+1), and finite exact geometric sum. Its even/odd simplification matches claimed formulas. First/two-point probabilities give mean 1, variance k(1-p^-1). Independently enumerated coefficient tuples for cubics p=2,k=1..3, p=3,k=1..2, p=5,k=1 and quartic p=2,k=2; checked Vandermonde/closed grouped expressions. Finite checks complement written all-k proof.
correctness.residual_risks: Applies uniform independent a0,a1,a2, degree at least 3, all p,k. Does not address moments >=4, degree<=2, conditioned polynomials or distribution of actual Qp roots. Relevant recent Simhi full text not read.

It is not just a tiny computation or known-table recomputation.
